children: Wall Street may have a date worth looking forward to. November 24 has historically delivered gains for U.S. stocks, with the S&P 500 finishing higher in 13 of 14 trading sessions on the date since 2000, according to Bluekurtic Market Insights.
Bluekurtic said November 24 has been the most bullish day of the year since 1950 in terms of both positivity rate and average gain.
The firm said the historical pattern supports its base case for a tactical bounce this week.
Data compiled by Bluekurtic showed the SPDR S&P 500 ETF
gained an average of 1.1% on November 24 across the 14 sessions, with a median return of 0.3%.
The average was lifted by a 6.9% gain in 2008; excluding that session, the average for the other 13 instances works out to about 0.7%.
